title: Map Frame
description: A rendered map's centre/rotation/extent/CRS/DEM/light config -- the constructor arguments for citymap.frame.Frame (tools/city-map/citymap/frame.py). Rotation and extent are deliberately NOT part of the L1 world cache key (see world.py's module docstring) -- they are the parameters an art-direction loop sweeps most, so re-editing this file after the world/fields caches already exist is cheap for rotation/extent changes and only re-fetches when center or crsEpsg actually moves the ground truth.

rotationDeg.description: Degrees CCW that source-CRS north is rotated to become map-space 'up'. See frame.py's to_map/to_source.

extentM.description: Side length of the square page, in ground metres.

crsEpsg.description: The source CRS EPSG code -- Japan has 19 plane-rectangular zones (JGD2011); Kurose/Kobe is zone VI, EPSG:6674.
